{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Sebiri]] '''village''' was located in the equatorial region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebiris]] near an ancient [[stone temple]]. It was home to around three dozen extended families, numbering around 200 individuals, and was run by a [[Unidentified Sebiri headman|headman]]. Although primitive, the villagers were aware of other [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and traded with them occasionally.
